title: Complete Shutter Down Paralyzes Rawalakot Poonch as Thousands Protest Against Punitive Measures, Power Cuts and Communication Blackouts
excerpt: Thousands shut down Rawalakot in protest against prolonged electricity outages, low voltage supply, and communication blackouts across District Poonch.
author: Special Correspondent, Rawalakot AK

heroImage.caption: Residents protest prolonged power cuts and communication blackouts in Rawalakot.

body.text: A complete shutter down brought life to a standstill in Rawalakot on Monday as thousands of residents from across District Poonch poured into the streets to protest prolonged power outages, severe load shedding, low voltage electricity, and persistent internet and mobile network disruptions.

Markets remained closed and traffic was largely halted as protesters marched through the city and gathered near the grid station, demanding an immediate end to what they described as collective punishment of the population.

body.caption: Protesters gather near the grid station demanding restoration of electricity.

body.text: Residents say Azad Kashmir has been subjected to extreme load shedding for several months, with the Poonch region facing between 15 and 20 hours of power cuts daily.

body.caption: Shuttered markets during the complete shutdown in Rawalakot.
